name: Nabejima Arisa
source:
The sister of the student council president, she is hostile to pretty much anyone (except [url=/c6899]Aoi[/url]) and holds a grudge against angels. She seems to be in love with Aoi and regularly tries to get her feelings across, but is always met with refusal.

[spoiler]In reality, she and Tsunaki aren't related by blood, as she was adopted to his family.[/spoiler]
